desc: 白底拖尾主图开场，膏体质地递证，主张全改空槽，信任收口
name: 日常面部保湿乳空槽卖点版式款

shots.intent: 用纯白管体加一条膏体拖尾在搜索列表里赢下第一眼点击。
一秒给出核心利益，右侧三枚勾选槽位承载可替换主张。
用不同肤色的无身份局部人群让买家自我代入，扩大适用面。
以侧脸局部演示膏体被推开的过程，证明清爽好吸收的观感。
把质地实物化陈列在圆盘上，用四角空槽解释配方主张位。
用微距纹理做最硬的质地证明，消除对厚重感的疑虑。
承接看背标习惯的买家，用空白参数行与空印章框承载规格信息位。
用九宫格空框印章阵列出排他承诺位，做降风险的信任陈列。
把单品升级为流程组合，用空白编号条引导连带购买。
以家庭照护情绪收口，把单品抬到全家可用的心智位并留行动槽。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, cool silver-white #F1F3F6 graphic fields for information screens, cool grey #DCE1E5 studio backdrop for people screens, one broad soft arc band along the bottom edge as the only graphic device
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight cobalt #1F6FB2 double-ring badges with blank centres plus solid cobalt check circles, never carrying legible text
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light from a large front-left softbox with a white fill card, cool neutral tone, controlled low speculars, soft contact shadows only
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical-minimal sensitive-skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, cool silver-white field #F1F3F6, deep cobalt accent #1F6FB2 and graphite-blue bars #16375C; cool neutral studio tone; modern geometric sans-serif with blanked label bars so no wording is ever rendered; one thin cobalt arc and one broad soft curved band as the only graphic devices; bright even high-key lighting from a large front-left softbox with a white fill card and soft contact shadows only; matte white acrylic, pale light-stone, pale marble and cool grey studio surfaces; thin single-weight line ring badges plus solid cobalt check circles with blank centres; stable upright product angle and identical product scale across every screen; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no legible rendered wording, no real seals or badges.
style.presentationRules: the tube keeps an identical scale and an upright cap-down stance on every screen, straight-on or at a slight 3/4 angle; the carton may sit beside it; nothing is ever clipped by the frame
style.surfaceSystem: matte white acrylic #FFFFFF, pale light-stone counter #E9E4DE, pale marble ledge #EDEBE8, pale matte disc #F7F6F4
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; all source wording stripped, headline and label areas remain blank bars reserved for copy
